units: Gen. XLVIII, 14) lattice-work of a fire place, grating, grille.

<cite ref="Pesachim 75a:2">Ib. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ מנוקבת</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="A01752"><he>אִי׳</he></cite>) perforated grille (with holes in the upright bars for the spit to turn in, v. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:2:2">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>צלי אסכלה</he> roasted over the grate.—Pl. <he>אַסְכָּלוֹת</he>. Sifré Num. s. 158.—<he>אַסְכָּלָאוֹת</he>.
Ab. Zar. 75ᵇ; Tanḥ. Ḥukk. 2.—Chald. pl. אַסְכָּלָתָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 31:23">Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 23</cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="I00763"><he>טַרְטְקָל</he></cite>. [Ἔσχαρα does not correspond in meaning.]
